description: Two four-input multiplexers sharing one pair of select inputs: each passes whichever of its four inputs the select number picks.

inputs.text: One of the four inputs into that multiplexer; it reaches the output while the select inputs name its number, counting I0 to I3.
Take this low to let that multiplexer through. While it is high that multiplexer's output is held at 0V.
The lower select input, worth one; together with S1 it picks which numbered input each multiplexer passes.
The upper select input, worth two; together with S0 it picks which numbered input each multiplexer passes.

outputs.text: 10V while that multiplexer is enabled and its selected input is high, 0V otherwise.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
The two enable inputs work the other way round from the rest of the plugin: with nothing patched they count as low, which is the enabled state, and taking one high shuts that multiplexer off.
S0 and S1 are not per-multiplexer; the number they set picks the same numbered input in both.
